key_highlights: Reserve Bank of Australia poised to raise the cash rate to an 18-year high amid sticky inflation.
Australian housing market correction accelerates, with Westpac predicting an 11% property price fall.
Westpac reports a $6.8B profit, but rising borrowing costs threaten bank credit growth and consumer demand.
Wall Street volatility and a $1.4T wipeout weigh heavily on ASX opening sentiment.

sectors.trend: Tightening monetary policy and surging debt servicing costs put pressure on loan books despite solid headline earnings.
sectors.implications: Mortgage growth deceleration and rising bad debt risks for major lenders (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Property values decline for the seventh consecutive month, approaching a 40-year record slump.
sectors.implications: Asset devaluations, elevated cap rates, and reduced buyer borrowing capacity impact REITs (MGR.AX, SGP.AX, DXS.AX).

sectors.trend: Gold market faces capitulation while targeted juniors ramp up WA drilling programs in gold and manganese.
sectors.implications: Margin pressure on gold miners (NST.AX, EVN.AX) and cautious sentiment for diversified miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).

sectors.trend: Global oil prices drop while domestic diesel shortages and surging power costs elevate operating risks.
sectors.implications: Revenue headwinds for oil & gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX); input cost inflation for transport and industrials.

sectors.trend: Consumer sentiment deteriorates under rate hike pressure, but opportunistic M&A emerges in retail.
sectors.implications: Weak spending dampens retail earnings, but takeover talks for Rip Curl owner (KMD.AX) indicate selective value.

key_themes: RBA monetary tightening to multi-decade high driving a sharper macroeconomic slowdown
Persistent nationwide residential housing downturn impacting household balance sheets
Global equity contagion following Wall Street sell-off and US midterm election uncertainty
Rising corporate debt costs triggering restructuring and job cuts across services

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive cyclicals; allocate to high-quality fixed income and cash equivalents.
Reduce exposure to retail mortgage-heavy banks and residential property developers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Equity Spillover & US Midterm Volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge equity exposure via index derivatives or defensive defensive dividend equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Diesel Supply Disruption & Power Cost Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor supply chain continuity and favor companies with strong energy cost pass-through capabilities.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on retail M&A and takeover interest
opportunities.rationale: Rip Curl owner KMD Brands in buyout discussions indicates opportunistic valuation floors in beaten-down consumer retail.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective positioning in high-potential exploration projects
opportunities.rationale: Targeted gold and battery metal exploration in WA continues to attract capital despite broader commodity weakness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to broad Australian equity benchmarks
defensive_moves.rationale: Pre-RBA rate decision weakness and US market contagion increase downside risks for the ASX 200.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to mortgage-heavy banks and residential REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Seven months of falling home prices and 11% projected declines heighten loan default and margin compression risks.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and defensive; ASX 200 faces headwinds from the anticipated RBA hike and global equity market instability.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral; stabilization contingent on rate plateauing, housing market bottoming, and recovery in major commodity export prices.
key_catalysts: RBA official cash rate announcement and post-meeting policy statement
US midterm election outcomes and subsequent trade/tax policy implications
Australian quarterly economic data including retail sales and wage growth indices
Major Australian banking sector annual AGM updates and margin commentary
watch_list: Crude oil (Brent/WTI) and gold spot prices
